title: Listening Drill — Bee visits
description: Short academic talk. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Bee visits
sections.transcript:
PRESENTER: Today I'm describing a small study of insect visits to garden flowers. I want you to listen for how the researchers measured change, because the result is easy to overstate.

PRESENTER: Their work took place in several plots beside a school. Instead of relying on what local people remembered, they recorded flower visits. They noticed afternoon peaks. That observation would have been missed if the team had visited only at the end.

PRESENTER: The largest limitation was rainy weather. The report is therefore a starting point. In a follow-up, the team would add drier weeks. A wider study could show whether the original pattern holds.
